_comment: Krea 2 LoRAs for local image generation. Copied to $DATA_DIR/image_loras.json on first use; edit that copy. When this example's version goes up, the copy is replaced (the old one is kept as image_loras.json.bak). kind: realism, detail, style, adult. Up to 3 adult LoRAs per image. strength is the default; range is what works. steps / scheduler / sampler override the Krea 2 Turbo defaults (8, simple, euler) when this LoRA is used. trigger is added to the prompt automatically. Notes starting GO-TO or AVOID steer the agent.

loras.label: Realism v1
loras.notes: Older photorealism LoRA; prefer Realism v2 when installed.

loras.label: Realism v2
loras.notes: Newer photorealism LoRA: skin, light, lens character. Good default for photo portraits; use instead of v1.

loras.label: Realistic snapshot
loras.notes: Candid phone-snapshot look: natural flash, casual framing, less polish.

loras.label: Enhancer
loras.notes: AVOID: gives poor results on this setup. Don't use it unless the user asks by name; use the photo-detail slider for crispness.

loras.label: Photo-detail slider
loras.notes: Pulls images back to photographic detail; raise towards 2 if results drift anime or plastic.

loras.label: Mystic XXX v3
loras.notes: GO-TO adult LoRA, together with SNOFS: the best adult results so far. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: SNOFS
loras.notes: GO-TO adult LoRA, together with Mystic XXX: the best adult results so far. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: NSFW Master Turbo
loras.notes: Adult content tuned for Turbo. Add as a third adult LoRA only when SNOFS + Mystic XXX aren't enough. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: Krea 2 NSFW v4
loras.notes: Adult content LoRA (Civitai 2725430). Alternative third adult LoRA when SNOFS + Mystic XXX aren't enough. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: Dark brush
loras.notes: Official Krea 2 style LoRA: muted minimalist ink sketch.

loras.label: Sunset blur
loras.notes: Official Krea 2 style LoRA: dreamy motion blur, sunset tones.

loras.label: SNOFS (Klein)
loras.notes: GO-TO adult LoRA for FLUX.2 Klein, the Klein 9b build of SNOFS. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: Klein NSFW (no face change)
loras.notes: GO-TO with SNOFS: adult content while leaving the face alone, which is what makes a character hold across shots.

loras.label: Klein NSFW Unlocked
loras.notes: Broader adult coverage. Use instead of SNOFS, not with it.

loras.label: NippleDiffusion (Klein)
loras.notes: Anatomical detail only; stacks with an adult LoRA rather than replacing one.

loras.label: Realism Engine (Klein)
loras.notes: Photographic skin and light. Safe to stack with anything.

loras.label: Mystic XXX (Z-Image)
loras.notes: GO-TO adult LoRA for Z-Image Turbo, the ZIT build of Mystic XXX. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: PhotoReal BetterNudes (Z-Image)
loras.notes: Alternative to Mystic XXX for Z-Image; use one or the other.
